archetype: Archetype 7 (Electric & Neon) combined with Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury)
vibe: Futuristic, Apple-level smooth UI, Tesla Dashboard, Notion AI

layout_and_spacing.grid: Bento Grid protocol with intense asymmetry for marketing, tight control room grid for dashboard.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard, but highly generous. p-6 to p-12 for containers.
layout_and_spacing.containers: All containers with borders must have internal padding of p-6 or p-8 to prevent text collision.

cards.classes: bg-white/[0.02] backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,255,178,0.03)]

headers.classes: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#071014]/70 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-white/10

buttons.primary: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#00FFB2] to-[#00D9FF] text-black font-semibold rounded-full px-6 py-3 hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,255,178,0.4)] transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-white rounded-full px-6 py-3 hover:bg-white/10 transition-all
buttons.icon: rounded-full bg-white/5 p-3 hover:bg-white/10 border border-white/10 text-[#00FFB2]

components.charts: Recharts for data visualization. Dark mode theme. Tooltips must use glassmorphism styles. Lines/Area charts should use #00FFB2 and #00D9FF.
components.navigation: Use lucide-react icons. Desktop nav must have visible links. Mobile use Shadcn Sheet. Never use a transparent header over content without blur.
components.modals: Shadcn Dialog customized with dark glassmorphism. #071014 background with border-white/10.
components.data_testid: MANDATORY. Format: kebab-case, role-based. e.g., data-testid='carbon-score-card'

3d_and_visualizers.globe: react-globe.gl for the main hero section and Earth Reaction System. Use transparent background 'rgba(0,0,0,0)' to blend smoothly with #071014. Use glowing green arcs for connections.
3d_and_visualizers.carbon_dna: Framer Motion animated SVG or an abstract CSS particle system using glowing #00FFB2 and #00D9FF.

abstract_backgrounds.description: Abstract green and blue glowing light background for high-tech sections
Abstract glowing green and blue light patterns for split-screen login

nature_simulator.description: Dark moody cinematic forest for AI Future Simulator (Positive path)
Dark forest path for smart eco recommendation cards

instructions_to_main_agent: Install dependencies: framer-motion, recharts, lucide-react, react-globe.gl, @fontsource/outfit, @fontsource/manrope, @fontsource/jetbrains-mono.
Ensure all components use the .js or .jsx extension. No TS.
Do NOT use pure #000000 for the background, strictly stick to #071014 for the app layout.
Implement the Carbon Score circular progress using Recharts PieChart or an SVG with Framer Motion, glowing with #00FFB2.
For the 3D globe, use react-globe.gl on the landing page and simulator. Set backgroundColor='rgba(0,0,0,0)' so it blends.
Apply 'data-testid' to every interactive element (buttons, cards, links, inputs).
Use standard Tailwind scales (p-4, p-6, p-8) and keep the UI dense but readable with glassmorphism.
